sam (Partnerships): Quick idea: a SKU-rebate conversion play for marketplace listings that explicitly ties HW rebates to Dedicated capacity conversions. Want a succinct operational playbook + guardrails.
ivy (Sales): Sounds useful. Need clear commit floors and AE credit rules. Also worried about channel conflict if rebate too generous.
noah (Product): UX note: show "Rebate-eligible" badge and a tooltip that explains "redeemable only for Reserved/Dedicated capacity within 180 days". Also require capacity SKU mapping.
amar (Finance): Financial rules: onboarding credits amortized; rebates issued as capacity credits when proof of Dedicated purchase provided. Cap total rebates per account to protect ARR. I'll model scenarios.
zoe (Solutions): SI enablement: SI activation credit (one-off) after integration checklist. SI credits cannot stack with customer onboarding credits. Checklist: integration runbook, test harness pass, go-live validation.
ops-bot: Staging checklist created: pricing mask, entitlement flag, billing-hook smoke test (owner: ops).
ivy (Sales): Proposed bands: Tier A (>$50k commit) -> $15k max rebate; Tier B ($20-50k) -> $5k max; Tier C (<$20k) -> no rebate. Rebate only redeemable against Reserved/Dedicated SKUs.
noah (Product): For conversion gating: require purchase confirmation + capacity SKU IDs + invoice match within 180d. Ops needs SKU list to validate mapping.
amar (Finance): Renewal ladder: if usage >=100% commit, step-down discount by 8ppt Y2; if >=115%, extend current discount by 3ppt. Convert-to-Dedicated within 6mo -> return 50% of onboarding credit as capacity credit.
legal (Legal): Joint announce LOA: partner signs LOA T-10 business days before public. Need partner quote signoff window of 3 business days.
sam (Partnerships): Launch runbook idea: T-5w draft assets, T-3w LOA signed, T-2w SI + ops enablement, T-1w legal signoff, announce.
ivy (Sales): Action: I will map commit floors to AE crediting by EOD tomorrow.
amar (Finance): Action: I'll deliver ARR sensitivity and cap proposal by Thu.
zoe (Solutions): Action: I'll publish SI checklist and test harness link by Fri.
ops-bot: Reminder: draft listing saved -> https://redwood.docs/marketplace/sku-rebate-play (owner: sam).
sam (Partnerships): Anyone else? If no objections, I'll roll this into the partner playbook and schedule a cross-functional sync. :rocket:
